sources.description: Arizona pulled off some midnight magic in a 29-26 win over TCU. Pro Football Focus gave the Wildcats (7-2, 4-2 Big 12) an overall mark of 77.9. The offense was given an overall mark of 69.3 and the defense was given a 71.2 overall mark. The best aspect of Arizona’s performance was the run defense […]
